note: Vectors for the Go port of capsule-engine #205's representing bridge and replay task-authority binding: capsulectl v0.1.0-rc20's represent checks on a seller's sale. Each file byte for byte from its source; this sidecar is not part of the vectors.
producer: capsulectl v0.1.0-rc20 (capsule-cli 401f39b54b6504750aa0e3de5a20749f85a5713c), core and deal plugin built from git archive of the tag with the release ldflags (capsulectl --version: capsulectl v0.1.0-rc20 (commit 401f39b54b6504750aa0e3de5a20749f85a5713c)), as for ../rc20-pickup-area-vectors

sources.sale.bundle.json, check-inputs/a-represe: out/ of a script in capsule-engine tests/fixtures/release-on-acceptance/build.sh's style, run with that rc20 capsulectl and deal plugin, materiality builtin:neutral, on a throwaway HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and plugin root, with a local stub rules checker that records each external-check-input/v0 and allows. One sale (deal sale new) whose intent orders the condition representation (intent.ordered_representations [condition]), two buyer threads (deal open --sale), then deal check --input of {"action":"represent","representing":{"class":C,"text":T}} on A for condition, authenticity, features and one class seller 0.1.4's s04 lists under requires_approval (approval-class), and on B for that class, and deal sale bundle.
